target_customer: Individual professionals, founders, investors and creators who want to keep up their personal and professional relationships
problem: People forget to follow up with acquaintances and contacts, and sales CRMs and note tools are a poor fit. Dex is a lightweight personal CRM with reminders and a Chrome extension.

founders.name: Kevin Sun
founders.background_notes: Named as founder on the YC page and Product Hunt listings; the Dex about page attributes the company to Dana HQ Inc. Background not found.

competitors.name: Monica
competitors.traction_then: Launched on Product Hunt in June 2017 and finished fourth on the day

competitors.name: UpHabit
competitors.what: Relationship app to stay connected with your network

technical_complexity.rationale: Contact store with reminders and a Chrome extension scraping social apps; mostly standard CRUD and integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar apps; stored relationship history and integrations create mild lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No big player took the personal CRM wedge in sources found; Clay, a rival launched in 2018, was later acquired by Automattic per Dex's own blog.

market_need_then: The founder wrote that he failed to keep up with Airtable and Notion and that Hubspot felt wrong for informal relationships; several competing personal CRM apps launched on Product Hunt in 2019, showing interest.

branding.domain_note: Uses getdex.com, a get prefix domain, not dex.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and thoughtful: turn acquaintances into allies

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches in 2024 and 2025 reached 186 and 94 upvotes; the site claims 30,000 plus users.

brand_strength.rationale: Short name with a get prefix domain and a modest Product Hunt following; no mascot or press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Dex is a small personal CRM from the YC Summer 2019 batch that has stayed independent, with about 7 people on the YC page and a claimed 30,000 users. Funding is only seen on aggregators and no exit, shutdown or layoffs were found, so it looks like a small subscription business rather than a venture scale outlier so far.
notes: Bouncewatch lists a 150K pre-seed on 2019-08-19 including Y Combinator and VCBacked lists 500K total, both single aggregators, unverified so not recorded as rounds. Republic fundraising page returned 403. Dex says it is backed by Y Combinator, Amino and Tapas Capital (search snippet), amounts unknown. The about page says Dex was founded in 2019 by Dana HQ Inc. Founder education and prior employers not found. Monica source predates the batch by two years and is still operating.
